method: floor = max(measured original-vs-original noise ceiling, frozen calibration) per viewport; threshold = floor + epsilon. The calibration (desktop 0.8822pp, mobile 0.4217pp) is the max observed across the verified baseline runs because a single 16-sample max is unstable. epsilon is a finite-sample margin (desktop 0.15pp, mobile 0.10pp) covering the residual spread of the noisiest skin (minimal), an order of magnitude below the smallest genuine divergence (1.45%), so it cannot hide a real difference.
